_comment: Skill templates; keys are skill names (identity, not overridable). Absent fields keep the compiled defaults. This file carries CONSTANTS and engine-checked data only -- never behaviour: trigger = action|passive|intention, target = none|self|any|multi|point, attack_test = none|melee|ranged (which also fixes the cast range), cooldown/intention_duration in seconds, castable_in_melee = whether the caster may be in melee contact, guaranteed_test = whether the declared test skips its gates and always crits, and per-skill constants each skill's own code reads by name.

Calcify.effect: Hardens the skin to stone; blows land, and glance.

ShieldBash.effect: Slams the target with a shield; a landed blow leaves it stunned.

Curse.effect: Saps the target's guard: less accurate, and its armour turns brittle.

DressWounds.effect: Binds a wound in the field; slow to come round again.

Backstab.effect: A blade between the ribs -- devastating against someone facing elsewhere.

PrecisionShot.effect: Draws a long breath, and does not miss.

Teleport.effect: Steps sideways out of the world, and back in somewhere else.

Sneak.effect: Slips out of sight; the next blow comes from nowhere.
